summary.description: One or two sentences: the stack and how it can be probed.

stack.description: For example: Spring Boot 3 (Java 17), Maven, JUnit 5, Mockito, H2

probeable.description: false when no safe way to run code from this repository's toolchain could be found; the planner then marks scenarios static

argv.description: The program and arguments that run one probe file, with {probe} where its path goes. No shell syntax.

file.description: The probe file name to write, such as Probe.java, probe.mjs or test_probe.py

seams.description: Safe ways to reach the changed code: standalone MockMvc, plain service calls, an in-memory database

avoid.description: What a probe must not use: booting the whole application context, real brokers or databases, external HTTP

setup_command.description: ADVISORY: the command that would prepare the checkout for the launch above. It is never run; a person sets it as probe_setup_command. Empty when unknown.
